author: Seung Wook
problem: stock lists (medicine, expiry date) pairs at a pharmacy, with dates written as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Return the names of the medicines whose expiry date has not passed as of the date today, in stock order.
bug_description: Keeps expiry > today instead of expiry >= today, so medicine expiring today is thrown out a day early.

comments.accurate: Medicines that can still be dispensed today, in stock order
comments.wrong_behavior: Medicines whose expiry date is still ahead of today, in stock order
comments.wrong_location: Expiry comparison verified; check the names come back in stock order
